english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for intentionally taking down a building or other structure.

exampleSentences.english: We will demolish this old building tomorrow.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我哋聽日會拆呢棟舊樓。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 wui5 caak3 ni1 dung6 gau6 lau4

english.note: Use this for taking down or demolishing a building or structure.

exampleSentences.english: They will tear down this old building next month.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 dung6 gau6 lau4 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 caak3
